name: @robotflowlabs/dashboard-web
description: Robot Flow Labs web dashboard for RoboROS

scripts.build: pnpm --dir ../runtime-core build && pnpm --dir ../bridge-lerobot build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir ../runtime-core build && pnpm --dir ../bridge-lerobot build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: pnpm --dir ../runtime-core build && pnpm --dir ../bridge-lerobot build && tsx src/server.ts
